text:
Sasha: FYI re: Newton outage follow-up. VPC peering flaps + agent reconnect storms. Need owners for audit, fix, and mitigation.
Ana: Split into three workstreams: peering audit, agent resilience, mitigation/canary.
Mike: I'll take the peering audit. Will run staging checklist and surface diffs. Opening RD-3567. ETA: Thu EOD.
Dilip: I'll own agent diagnostics and a code change to reduce reconnect aggression + add jitter. Need full agent logs.
Juniper: Logs uploaded: s3://redwood-cust/newton/2155550000-agentlogs.tar.gz. Observed repeated 502s and kernel drops ~02:16 UTC.
Sasha: Short-term mitigation: scoped public fallback for telemetry/health only (`monitor_only_public_fallback=true`). Who can run canary?
Mike: I will. Plan: 10% nodes tonight, monitor 2 hours, ramp if stable. Will post dashboards.
Ana: I'll update the postmortem doc with owners, deliverables, and mark this as a potential recurring pattern for weekly triage until cleared.
Dilip: Created RD-3568 for agent backoff fix (PR soon). Aim to merge & release next sprint.
oncall-bot: Reminder: incident follow-up sync Thu 16:00 UTC — https://zoom.redwood/incident-followup
Juniper: Confirming: fallback limited to telemetry/health only? No customer payloads to public internet?
Sasha: Correct — telemetry/health endpoints only, no inference payloads or PII. Will document exact endpoints and publish to the postmortem.
Ana: Security scoped approval received (sec@redwood). I'll attach approval to the postmortem.
Mike: Canary datapoint: error rate dropped ~18% -> ~2% within 30m for canary group. Dashboard link posted in internal dash channel.
Dilip: PR ready: https://github.com/redwood/agent/pull/1017 — reduces reconnect aggression, adds clearer logs and jitter. Needs final review.
Sasha: Owner recap: peering audit — Mike (RD-3567); agent fix — Dilip (RD-3568); canary & rollout — Mike; postmortem & sec attachments — Ana; weekly triage — Sasha. Target remediation complete by 2026-04-10.
Juniper: We'll watch Newton from their side and report anomalies.
Mike: Playbook tweak: add MTU and AS-path verification + route propagation validation before marking isolation resolved. I'll update infra-playbooks.
Dilip: After merge I'll cut a hotfix release and schedule deployment aligned with Mike's rollout window.
Sasha: If tasks slip, escalate to oncall SRE. I'll migrate these actions into Jira and close loop. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
